inclusions.text: Seven nights aboard a five-star Nile cruise ship
inclusions.source: Seven of the eleven nights are spent aboard a five-star cruise ship moving between Luxor and Aswan, and this changes the character of the trip entirely.
Your party travels with its own Egyptologist; aboard you have a private cabin on a standard 4–5 star Nile class vessel.

inclusions.text: Private cabin on a standard 4–5 star Nile class vessel
inclusions.source: Your party travels with its own Egyptologist; aboard you have a private cabin on a standard 4–5 star Nile class vessel.
After breakfast the next morning, you are transferred to Cairo International Airport.

itinerary.title: Giza and Saqqara
itinerary.source: Day one is Giza and Saqqara.

itinerary.title: Flight south to Luxor, board cruise
itinerary.source: An early flight carries you south to Luxor, and on arrival you board the cruise that will be your home for the next seven nights.

itinerary.title: Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut, Colossi
itinerary.source: The third day is the heaviest of the cruise section.

itinerary.title: River day: Edfu and Kom Ombo
itinerary.source: Day four is a river day between two temple stops.

itinerary.title: Aswan: High Dam and Philae
itinerary.source: Aswan is the southernmost main city on the route, where the Nile narrows toward the first cataract.

itinerary.title: Leisure day on the cruise
itinerary.source: The sixth day is left open — a structural necessity rather than an indulgence.

itinerary.title: Return briefly to Kom Ombo
itinerary.source: The seventh day returns briefly to Kom Ombo before the ship continues upstream — the light is different in the morning than in the late afternoon, and the site is typically quieter.

itinerary.title: Luxor, given to Karnak
itinerary.source: The ship returns to Luxor for the eighth day, given to Karnak — not a temple so much as a temple city.

itinerary.title: Flight back to Cairo
itinerary.source: A flight carries you back to Cairo for the trip's final chapter.

itinerary.title: Cairo's own day, Nile dinner cruise
itinerary.source: The tenth day is Cairo's own.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Cairo International Airport
itinerary.source: After breakfast the next morning, you are transferred to Cairo International Airport.
